spoken: [hook] You have more dreams than you can hold. || Some live in your notes app. Some live in your head. And most of them quietly fade away. || [turn] So what if they all lived in one place? || You write your dream down today, and Dmyor keeps it for you. So years from now, you can open it and see where it all started. || Then you break it down. The big dream becomes milestones, and the milestones become small steps you can actually take this week. || [land] And one small step at a time, you watch it grow. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
dream: Open my own design studio by 2028.
